description.en: Reads the current state of the engine camera move: the array receives the position in elements 0 to 2 and the look-at point in elements 3 to 5. The engine camera move is the one started with CMND_SET_MOVE_INFO_CAMERA; only one camera can be moving at a time. If the handle is not the moving camera, the array is left unchanged.
Receives [posX, posY, posZ, refX, refY, refZ]; create it with 6 elements.
Always null; the results are in the array.
